description_en: Queries whether a running SQL engine exists
kebab_example: aliyun adb exist-running-sql-engine --db-cluster-id amv-bp1cit7z8j0000 --resource-group-name spark_test --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExistRunningSQLEngine

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the name of the resource group for a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口查看指定集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether a running SQL engine exists in the resource group.

Valid values:

True
False
Data.description_zh:
选定资源组是否存在运行中的Spark SQL Engine。

取值：
True：存在。
False：不存在
